{MACD经典金叉}<br>
DIFF:=EMA(CLOSE,12)-EMA(CLOSE,26);<br>
DEA:=EMA(DIFF,9);<br>
CROSS(DIFF,DEA) AND RANGE(DEA,-0.01,0.01);</td></tr></tbody></table>
